name: press
description: Publish identity-gated HTML reports with the press CLI. Two skills walk an agent from zero to a shared URL: press-setup acquires and verifies an auth token, press-publish composes a report, publishes it, and confirms the returned URL and its access control.

interface.shortDescription: Publish identity-gated HTML reports via the press CLI
interface.longDescription: Two skills take an agent from auth setup to a shared URL: press-setup acquires and verifies a token; press-publish composes an HTML report, publishes it, and confirms the returned URL and its access control.
defaultPrompt: Set up press auth and verify my token
Publish this HTML report with press and share the URL
Publish a private press page and confirm its access control
